description: This file contains utility functions for restoring and managing the state dictionaries of traced PyTorch modules, especially after functional tracing or export. It handles extracting underlying modules, cleaning up traced parameters and buffers, and ensuring the correct fully qualified names are used in the traced graph.

methods.name: torch.nn.Module _get_underlying_module( module_or_method: torch.nn.Module | Callable[..., Any], )
methods.description: Extracts the underlying nn.Module from either a module or a bound method, raising a TypeError if the input is invalid.

methods.name: None _clear_traced_params_buffers( traced_module: torch.fx.GraphModule, const_keys: Sequence[str] )
methods.description: Removes specified constants from the traced module's buffers and reassigns them as attributes to prevent them from appearing in the state dict.

methods.name: None _restore_state_dict( original_module: torch.nn.Module | Callable[..., Any], traced_module: torch.fx.GraphModule, )
methods.description: Restores the traced module's state dict to match the original module, updating parameter and buffer names, and fixing get_attr nodes in the graph to reflect correct FQNs.

ctags.name: _restore_state_dict
ctags.signature: ( original_module: torch.nn.Module | Callable[..., Any], traced_module: torch.fx.GraphModule, )
